line: Crowley's account of Atu XVIII: the letter Qoph, Pisces, and the Moon as her lowest avatar joining Netzach to Malkuth.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter and the sign, and Crowley's account of the Moon among the planets.

quotes.quote: The Eighteenth Trump is attributed to the letter Qoph, which represents Pisces in the Zodiac.
The Moon, partaking as she does of the highest and the lowest, and filling all the space between, is the most universal of the Planets.

sections.title: Its path on the Tree, and what it figures
sections.line: The path joins Netzach with Malkuth in her lowest avatar. Crowley reads the card as the threshold of life and of death.

quotes.quote: In this Trump, her lowest avatar, she joins the earthy sphere of Netzach with Malkuth,
This is the threshold of life; this is the threshold of death.
